prompt.en: "Bronze Age civilisations developed independently but shared common features." Examine this statement with reference to the civilisations in the chapter.

label.en: All four arose in fertile river plains: the Sindhu and Sarasvati, the Tigris and Euphrates, the Nile, and the Huang He

level1.en: The Sindhu-Sarasvati, the Tigris-Euphrates, the Nile, the Huang He - what do all four of these have in common as a place to live?

clue.en: All four arose in fertile river plains: the Sindhu and Sarasvati, the Tigris and Euphrates, the Nile, and the Huang He.

level2Template.en: All four early world civilisations arose independently in fertile ___ with water and rich soil.

label.en: Farming produced a surplus that could support people who did other work

level1.en: A city needs potters, priests and builders who never touch a field. What has to exist first for people like that to eat at all?

clue.en: Good land and better methods gave more food than the farmers needed, which supported artisans, traders and officials.

level2Template.en: High agricultural productivity generated a dependable ___ that supported people who did not farm.

label.en: Urban cities emerged in all these centres, each with its own kind of buildings

level1.en: Once there is a surplus, what grows up in all four regions?

clue.en: Cities grew in all four regions, but their plans and great buildings differed.

level2Template.en: Economic growth led to the emergence of ___ in all these major centres.

label.en: Each developed writing, which recorded economic transactions and social activities and later carried literary texts

level1.en: All four had a script. Did it do the same first job everywhere?

clue.en: All four had writing, but it did different first jobs: lists of goods in Sumer and questions on bone in China. The Harappan script is unread.

level2Template.en: Each society developed its own system of ___ to record economic transactions and social activities.

label.en: Each developed social and administrative systems independently

level1.en: Canals and stores need organising. What did each civilisation develop to do this?

clue.en: Each developed ways of running the state and ordering society, with people at different levels.

level2Template.en: To organise labour and keep order, each civilisation developed its own ___ and social levels.

text.en: The major Bronze Age civilisations developed independently, yet they shared common features.
All four early world civilisations arose independently in fertile ___ with water and rich soil.
High agricultural productivity generated a dependable ___ that supported people who did not farm.
Economic growth led to the emergence of ___ in all these major centres.
Each society developed its own system of ___ to record economic transactions and social activities.
To organise labour and keep order, each civilisation developed its own ___ and social levels.
Each civilisation reached these features in its own way, so they share a list and not a copy.
